assistant.common.name: Name
assistant.agent.welcome: Hello. Tell me which room you want to add, for example, “I want to add the office.” If measurements or a floor plan are missing, I’ll ask for them. You can preview every change before applying it.
assistant.agent.setupRequired: The assistant has not been configured yet. In Home Assistant, go to Settings → Devices & services → HomeTwin → Configure and enter the address of an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, model, and API key.
assistant.agent.applySuccess: Applied. You can still move everything in the model.
assistant.sh3d.invalidArchive: Not a valid .sh3d file (not a ZIP archive)
assistant.sh3d.missingHomeXml: The file does not contain Home.xml. Please save it with Sweet Home 3D version 5.3 or later.
assistant.wizard.title: Floor Plan Assistant
assistant.wizard.recognizeRoomsAndScale: Use AI to recognize rooms + scale
assistant.wizard.fileFormats: PNG, JPG, PDF · Ctrl+V pastes an image directly
assistant.wizard.newLevelPlaceholder: read from the plan, e.g. First floor
assistant.wizard.existingLevelHint: The rooms on this level will be replaced (or added to) when you apply the result.
assistant.wizard.onePlanPerLevel: Use one floor plan per level. Photos of paper plans work too; you can straighten them in the next step.
assistant.wizard.clipboardNoImage: There is no image on the clipboard.
assistant.wizard.clipboardDenied: The browser cannot read the clipboard here. Press Ctrl+V (Mac: ⌘+V) in this window.
assistant.wizard.alignHint: Drag the corners to crop the plan. For plans photographed at an angle, drag each corner to the corresponding paper corner to correct the perspective.
assistant.wizard.aiScaleTip: You do not have to measure anything. AI reads dimension chains during recognition. Just select “Use AI to recognize rooms + scale” below. Measure only if the plan has no dimensions or you want to set the scale yourself.
assistant.wizard.manualMeasureHint: Measure manually: choose a known distance, ideally a long dimension chain or dimensioned exterior wall. Click the start, click the end, then enter the length. Points snap to lines (hold Alt to disable snapping) and can still be moved afterward. Zoom with the mouse wheel or two fingers; pan with the right mouse button or by dragging once the distance has been set.
assistant.wizard.scaleSummary: Scale: {pixels} pixels per metre · Image {width} × {height} m
assistant.wizard.checkDistanceHint: Measure a second dimensioned distance (orange) and enter its length.
assistant.wizard.tapToUseDistance: Select a distance to use it.
assistant.wizard.measureStepEnd: 2. Click the end of the {distance} (Esc cancels)
assistant.wizard.measureDone: Done. You can still drag the points.
assistant.wizard.measureStepLength: 3. Enter the length on the right
assistant.wizard.distanceTooShort: The distance is too short — click farther away for the endpoint.
assistant.wizard.aiSearchingDimensionsIn: AI is looking for dimensions in the plan …
assistant.wizard.jobMissing: The job no longer exists (was Home Assistant restarted?)
assistant.wizard.progressModelReading: Model is reading the plan (the first response may take 10–40 s)
assistant.wizard.progressFitting: Fitting rooms to plan dimensions and checking them
assistant.wizard.slowDetectionHint: This is taking longer than usual. Processing time depends on the model and floor plan. The server stops after 4 minutes. The job continues even if you close the assistant.
assistant.wizard.noReadableDimensions: No readable dimension chains found — please measure a distance manually.
assistant.wizard.scaleAppliedFromDimensi: Scale taken from the “{length} m” dimension chain — please check it briefly.
assistant.wizard.manualWithoutAi: Without AI, you can trace the rooms yourself. The scaled plan will be placed on the level as a template.
assistant.wizard.aiSetupHint: Set up AI under Settings → Devices & services → HomeTwin → Configure (endpoint, vision-capable model, API key).
assistant.wizard.useAsTemplate: Use plan as template and draw rooms manually
assistant.wizard.modelRecommendation: Model: {model}. Recommended: Opus 5.5 or a comparably capable model with image understanding.{scale}
assistant.wizard.scaleReadDuringRecognit: The scale will be read from the dimension chains in the plan.
assistant.wizard.secondPassOption: Second pass: AI checks its result (more accurate, roughly twice as long)
assistant.wizard.aiHintsPlaceholder: e.g. The garage on the left is unheated. The hall spans the full width of the house.
assistant.wizard.secondPassChecking: Pass 2 of 2: AI is checking its result …
assistant.wizard.secondPassRejected: Second pass rejected (deviation {secondError} % instead of {firstError} %, size ×{ratio}) — first pass used
assistant.wizard.secondPassAccepted: Second pass: AI checked its result
assistant.wizard.secondPassUnusable: Second pass returned no usable result — first pass used
assistant.wizard.secondPassFailed: Second pass failed ({error}) — first pass used
assistant.wizard.scaleReadFromDimensions: Scale read from the dimension chains in the plan
assistant.wizard.manualTemplateToast: The plan is now a template on the level. Trace rooms with the rectangle or polygon tool.
assistant.wizard.areaMismatch: “{name}”: {actual} m² clear area, {planned} m² on the plan
assistant.wizard.reviewSummary: {rooms} rooms · {openings} openings{stairs} · {area} m² living area (clear dimensions){duration}
assistant.wizard.scaleMismatch: ⚠ The dimension chains in the plan produce a scale that differs by {percent} %. Select to apply it.
assistant.wizard.recognizeAgainHint: Locked rooms remain; the rest will be recognized again using your instructions.
assistant.wizard.recognizeAgainPlacehold: e.g. Bathroom and WC are two rooms
assistant.wizard.mapAreas: Match Home Assistant areas by name
assistant.wizard.reviewEditHint: Drag corners in the image; select a room by clicking it. The grid is 5 cm and corners snap to adjacent rooms.
assistant.wizard.clickNearRoomEdge: Please click closer to a room edge.
assistant.wizard.scaleApplied: Scale applied from the dimension chains.
assistant.wizard.outdoorTrimmed: Trimmed {count} outdoor area(s) to the walls.
assistant.wizard.nothingToTrim: Nothing to trim (only rectangular outdoor areas can be trimmed automatically).
assistant.wizard.openingToolHint: {type}: click a room edge. Select the button again to stop.
assistant.wizard.drawRectangle: Draw a rectangle on the plan.
assistant.wizard.openingsSummary: {doors} doors · {windows} windows{garages}{passages}. Choose a tool and click a room edge; select an opening to edit it, then drag the ends to change its width.
assistant.wizard.importCreated: Walls, doors, and windows have been created. Undo reverts the entire import.
assistant.wizard.reviewImportTip: Please check briefly: windows, doors, and stairs. AI is most likely to miss something there. Select the stairs → set shape (straight, L, U), direction, and height.
assistant.wizard.reviewToolsToast: Doors/windows: tools at the top. The stairs are selected — set shape and direction on the right.
assistant.wizard.assignDevicesPrompt: Assign the lights, blinds, sensors, and thermostats on level “{name}” to the rooms.
assistant.wizard.noRoofInPlan: The plan did not specify a roof. Choose one — you can change everything later in the editor.
assistant.wizard.moreRoofsHint: Add more roofs (garden shed, extension, etc.) anytime in the editor: select a room → “Roof on this room”.
assistant.wizard.roofAppliedToast: Roof applied — adjust details under “Roof” in the editor.
assistant.wizard.heightsDefaultHint: The plan does not state every height, so typical values are used. Check them against your plans; you can change them later under Edit → storey.
assistant.wizard.heightsStackHint: The storey sits directly on the slab above the storey below, without gaps.
assistant.wizard.heightsBelowHint: Basement: the storey above keeps its floor level; the basement height closes the gap.
assistant.wizard.heightsMismatch: The plan level (+{plan} m) does not match the room height and slab of the storey below. HomeTwin stacks the storeys without gaps at {elevation}; adjust the room height of the storey below if needed.
assistant.wizard.modelAnswerCopied: Model answer copied. Please attach it to a bug report.
assistant.wizard.noRoomsReturned: The recognition finished without rooms. Use “Copy model answer” and try again or use another model.
